standard_prerequisites.name: Models, resolutions of singularities in dimension one, and the pre-existence lemma
standard_prerequisites.statement: A model of a smooth projective curve over the fraction field of a discrete valuation ring is a flat proper scheme over the ring with that curve as generic fibre; the chapter proves separately that a certain construction always produces a model that admits a morphism from every other regular proper model, and it records the resolution of singularities available for the one-dimensional schemes that occur here. The author's own statements of those results are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted proposition is the existence statement on which the definition of a minimal model and the uniqueness results of the surrounding sections rest.

core_obligations: Produce a projective model: choose a closed immersion of the curve into a projective space over the fraction field and take the scheme theoretic image of the induced map into the projective space over the discrete valuation ring (source lines 4524-4527).
Check that this image is a model of the curve over the ring, which is the content of the quoted lemma on the image of a curve being a model (source line 4527).

Resolve the singularities of that projective model, obtaining a regular proper scheme over the ring which is again a model of the curve, and note that properness is preserved because a composition of proper morphisms is proper (source lines 4528-4532).
Apply the pre-existence lemma to the regular proper model just obtained to conclude that a minimal model exists (source lines 4532-4534).

proof_roadmap.step: Embed the curve in a projective space and take the scheme theoretic image to obtain a projective model.
Resolve the singularities of that model and keep properness under the composition.
Apply the pre-existence lemma to obtain a minimal model.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Proposition proposition-exists-minimal-model（源 4518-4522 行，证明 4524-4534 行）：设 C 是 K 上的光滑射影曲线且 H^0(C,O_C)=K，则极小模型存在。关键操作不是例行核验：证明要先选闭浸入 C→P^n_K 并取 C→P^n_R 的概型论像，得到 R 上的射影模型（4524-4527 行），再对该模型做奇点消解得到正则 proper 模型并注意 properness 在复合下保持（4528-4532 行），最后把预存在引理接上得到极小模型（4532-4534 行）。难点在于把「存在性」化归为「先造一个射影模型、再消解、再用预存在引理」这条三步链条，并保证每一步都落在本章允许引用的既有结论上；原文位置在证明的 4524-4527、4528-4532、4532-4534 行。
